scenarios.scenario_abstract: At a crowded stadium concert, [X] repeatedly reaches for a phone and payment card while keeping ID and the only car key in separate secured positions and both hands free for movement through the stands.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在拥挤的体育场演唱会中，[X]会反复取用手机和支付卡，同时把证件与唯一的车钥匙分别固定在安全位置，并让双手保持空闲以便在人群和看台间移动。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While studying daily in central Madrid cafes, [X] carries an expensive laptop, mouse, charger, audio gear, cards, and keys between small tables, metro rides, and short walks, requiring protected device storage and discreet access during frequent setup and packing.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 每天在马德里市中心咖啡馆学习时，[X]会在狭小桌面、地铁和短途步行之间搬动昂贵笔记本电脑、鼠标、充电器、音频设备、银行卡和钥匙，需要在频繁展开与收起设备时保护电脑并保持低调取用。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Across airports, trains, metros, museums, and hotels in a five-day Italy trip, [X] keeps passport, downloaded tickets, cards, cash, phone, and charging equipment quickly accessible without concentrating every identity and payment item in one place.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在五天意大利行程的机场、火车、地铁、博物馆和酒店之间移动时，[X]会让护照、离线票证、银行卡、现金、手机和充电设备便于取用，同时避免把所有身份与支付物品集中在一个位置。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When cleaning a home alone under a timer, [X] moves one compact supply caddy from room to room, separating sprays, cloths, gloves, waste bags, and small tools so wet or contaminated items never mix with clean ones.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 独自在限定时间内清洁住宅时，[X]会把一只紧凑的清洁用品提篮带到各个房间，将喷剂、抹布、手套、垃圾袋和小工具分开放置，避免潮湿或受污染物品与干净用品混在一起。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: [X] uses small cash at street stalls and markets but contactless cards at hotels and larger restaurants, keeping the main card, backup card, debit card, passport copy, and daily cash in separate secured positions through crowded transit.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]会在街头餐摊和市场使用小额现金，在酒店和较大餐厅改用非接触式银行卡，并在拥挤交通中把主卡、备用卡、借记卡、护照副本和当日现金分别放在安全位置。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a two-week family holiday, [X] and another adult repeatedly hand off snacks, wipes, a tablet, travel documents, first aid, water, sun protection, and stroller-related items as one person alternates between supervising children and handling luggage.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 两周家庭假期中，[X]和另一位成人会随着一人照看孩子、另一人处理行李而反复交接零食、湿巾、平板、旅行文件、急救品、饮水、防晒用品和婴儿车相关物品。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before a graduation surprise, [X] transports a slideshow laptop, printed signs, invitations, tape, small tools, cards, cables, a speaker, and fragile photo props, keeping setup pieces findable while concealing the event materials from the graduate.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在毕业惊喜揭晓前，[X]会携带播放照片合辑的电脑、打印标牌、请柬、胶带、小工具、贺卡、线缆、音箱和易损拍照道具，让布置用品容易找到，同时不向毕业生暴露惊喜。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a train-and-rural-transit visit to a grandmother not seen since childhood, [X] protects gifts and family photographs separately from medicine, money, tickets, electronics, and a story notebook while keeping both hands available during transfers and reunion.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 乘火车和乡村交通去探望自幼年后便未再见的祖母时，[X]会把礼物与家庭照片同药品、钱财、票证、电子设备和记录往事的笔记本分开保护，并在转乘和重逢时腾出双手。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: During a quiet beach trip with a three-year-old, [X] repeatedly retrieves diapers, wipes, snacks, familiar food, medicine, sunscreen, spare clothes, toys, water, and a phone with one hand while the other remains available to supervise or comfort the child.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 与三岁孩子进行安静海滨旅行时，[X]会在一只手照看或安抚孩子的同时，用另一只手反复取出尿布、湿巾、零食、熟悉食物、药品、防晒霜、替换衣物、玩具、水和手机。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Across metro, high-speed rail, buses, and domestic flights in Korea, [X] repeatedly separates a daily load of passport, transit and payment cards, cash, phone, power bank, rain gear, and purchases from a medium suitcase and changes carrying mode on stairs and platforms.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 通过地铁、高铁、公交和国内航班穿行韩国多座城市时，[X]会反复把护照、交通卡与支付卡、现金、手机、充电宝、雨具和购物物品组成的当日负载同中型行李箱分开，并在楼梯和站台改变携带方式。

professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract: A bicycle food-delivery rider works long shifts through theft-prone neighborhoods, separating hot food, cold items, and spillable drinks while repeatedly accessing a lock, phone, power bank, keys, ID, patch kit, and water, and shifting cargo off the back or into a more secure body-close position as load size and street risk change.
professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 一名自行车外卖配送员在盗窃风险较高的街区长时间工作，需要分开热食、冷食和易洒饮料，并反复取用车锁、手机、充电宝、钥匙、证件、补胎工具和饮水；随着订单体积和街道风险变化，还要把货物从背部转移到车载位置或更贴身安全的位置。
